hero.title: Source products from China,
hero.titleAccent: delivered to your business in India.
hero.sub: Tell us what you need. Our team in China finds and checks factories, sends you a clear quotation, and manages shipping and customs all the way to your door.

how.title: How it works
how.sub: Four clear steps from idea to container.
how.d1: Product, quantity, target price and photos — by form, phone or WhatsApp.
how.d2: Our China team shortlists verified factories, compares offers and arranges samples.
how.d3: One quotation with price, MOQ, lead time and validity — in USD, RMB or INR as agreed.
how.d4: Inspection, freight booking, customs clearance and tracking until delivery.

download.title: Source Easy for Android
download.sub: Leads, quotations, shipments and chat on your phone — works offline and syncs when you are back online. For Source Easy staff in India and China.
download.notYet: The Android app has not been published yet. Please check back soon.
steps: Tap “Download APK” on your Android phone (or scan the QR code from your computer).
Open the downloaded file source-easy.apk from the notification or your Downloads folder.
If Android asks, allow your browser or Files app to “Install unknown apps” (Settings → Apps → Special access → Install unknown apps).
Tap Install, then open Source Easy and sign in with your staff email and password.
To update later, download the new APK from this page and install it over the old one — your data stays.
download.safety: Only download the app from this page on the official Source Easy site. Android may warn because the app is not from the Play Store; that is expected.
